description: Synthetic, committed, network-free. Every case is answerable from the fixtures under sources/ and the transcripts under transcripts/. Cases select their own profile: the failing fixtures live in profiles of their own so a source that always fails cannot make every case report degraded coverage. Budgets and thresholds here are absolute first-run placeholders, to be replaced by regression bounds once measured distributions exist.

baseline.note: Measured over 41 cases on darwin/arm64, all nine gates passing. nDCG@10 0.7665, Recall@5 0.9028, Recall@20 1.0, MRR@10 0.6553, Success@5 1.0; abstention, coverage, provenance, source-outcome and locator accuracy all 1.0. Cold and warm runs produced identical metrics - the index is rebuilt at handshake either way, so there is no warm path to diverge from - and p95 was 81ms against a 400ms budget, roughly 5x headroom rather than a number tuned to just pass. exact_identifier_success_at_1 is 0.4 and is recorded as a floor, not a target: two of five identifier cases put a document's title chunk above the section judged authoritative, which is the first thing worth improving.
